label: Water on and under land
text: EA.O.A4.2 Water on and under land. Water balance for a drainage basin over a period: P = ET + Q + ΔS (precipitation, evapotranspiration, runoff, storage change). Groundwater and aquifer claims (transmissivity, storativity) are owned here. Darcy's law q = −K∇h holds for laminar flow (Reynolds number below about 1–10) in a saturated, rigid porous medium. Its owner is EN transport closure (uses EN.O.A2); CONTESTED, alternative PH continuum. The well is EN.
